description.en:
Tells whether a character is still moving or turning under a command of the movement manager (CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG, CMND_CHR_PATH_SETUP, CMND_CHR_TURN_*). The events loop on it with suspend() to wait for a move to end (over 2200 calls).
It checks the character's two action states in its slot (one for moving, one for turning). A character with no slot counts as not moving.
Character moves and turns are run by a movement manager with 16 slots, one per character. CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG, CMND_CHR_PATH_SETUP and the CMND_CHR_TURN_* commands take a free slot for the character when it has none.

true while a move or turn is running, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Waiting for two turns (real usage, from ev42011600.nut)
